name: Verifed V23
description: Redesigns the welcome screen with a dark green frame, warm food cards, four real local food photos, swipe and button carousel controls, Clash Grotesk, and direct account creation, sign-in and guest actions.
verification: 169 automated tests passed. iOS, Android and web exports succeeded.
Four food-card images were visually reviewed in the browser. Indicator buttons and next arrows changed the active photo. Welcome was reviewed at 390x700 and 320x568.
Get started opened account creation, Sign in opened the existing login form, and Explore as guest restored Home and its normal navigation.
All active fonts, Home photos, 356 food images and the Spanish menu image matched source bytes in every platform export. Snack verified all 374 uploaded asset hashes.
Native swipe gestures, physical iPhone safe-area rendering and remote Snack runtime were not re-tested for this update. Snack ZIP comparison remains unavailable: SNACK_DOWNLOAD_TOO_LARGE.
